_note: Godot-only game modes (not in the web game). ModeRules.merge_extra() adds these to shared/modes.json at load. allowFrom / dropsAs = copy that mode's weapon list and crate pool. teams = players per side; flexTeams = the Players page sets the side size (odd bot counts only). dropAllow = the crate pool. lowg (Moon Drift) is a web mode (MODES.lowg, index.html ~3091) that tools/export-content.js misses because it is added after the MODES literal: copied here by hand. practice = the Practice Range (the web PRACTICE button: the practice / test maps with their dummies).

tdm.name: Team Deathmatch
tdm.desc: Two teams, no friendly fire. First team to 30 K.O.s

deathmatch.name: Death Match
deathmatch.desc: Free for all. First to 20 K.O.s wins

sudden.name: Sudden Death
sudden.desc: One life each. A K.O. or a fall and you are out. Last one standing wins

chaos.name: Chaos
chaos.desc: 5 vs 5 with random events: crate rain, low gravity, knockback storms, giants. First team to 50

lowg.name: Moon Drift
lowg.desc: Super low gravity. Float, soar and knock rivals around

practice.name: Practice Range
practice.desc: Dummies that stand, slide and pop back up, and a rack of weapons to try. No score
